episode.subject: ground pangolin
episode.title: Claws held clear
episode.body:
Walked across the hard ground with my front claws tucked up. A small stone shifted beneath one hind foot. Put a forefoot down, steadied myself, lifted it again.

Nobody saw. I checked.

Then I crossed the rest of the patch in that dignified, careful posture and immediately used the protected claws to dig open an ant tunnel. They were being saved for something much less delicate than walking.

originalBody:
Walked across the hard ground with my front claws tucked up. A small stone shifted beneath one hind foot. Put a forefoot down, steadied myself, lifted it again.

Nobody saw. I checked.

Then I crossed the rest of the patch in that dignified, careful posture and immediately used the protected claws to tear apart a mound. They were being saved for something much less delicate than walking.
verdict: PASS. The one-phrase correction removes the overstated destruction and fits documented shallow ant-tunnel foraging. The exact side-on photograph continues to earn foreclaws-clear walking, while a brief stumble and later excavation are openly fictional temporal details. The bodily contrast survives: careful locomotion followed by forceful digging with the same claws. Nobody saw is a conventional aside, but the payoff depends on this species-specific limb use rather than an invented audience.
canon: Existing adult Mallow, Kruger home, avatar and all other literal passages unchanged. No inferred photo sequence. This is distinct from her admitted defensive ball/hunger scene.
